user.title: Hue-Lite
user.description:
Hue-style scenes, a Natural light scene that follows the sun, and wake-up, evening and coming-home routines for your lights.

Lights take part through labels: Evening, Wake up, Nightlight, Coming home and Exclude from lighting. Hue-Lite uses the ones you already have and creates the rest.

data_description.presence: The zone whose number of people decides coming home, leaving home and whether the evening routine starts.
data_description.dimmers: Let Hue Dimmer Switches (RWL02x) paired with ZHA control the lights in their area.

create_entry.default:
Give your lights an area and the labels of the routines they should join. For the Lights dashboard, add a dashboard (Settings → Dashboards → Add dashboard → New dashboard from scratch), open it, choose Edit dashboard → ⋮ → Raw configuration editor, and replace everything with:

strategy:
  type: custom:hue-lite

Reload the browser first so it has Hue-Lite's dashboard.

init.title: Hue-Lite options
init.description: Which label puts a light into each routine. Lights without an area or label take part in scenes from the dashboard and dimmers only.

data_description.label_evening: Lights the evening routine takes: on before sunset, through the scenes, off at bedtime.
data_description.label_wake_up: Lights that fade up at the wake-up time.
data_description.label_nightlight: Lights that get Nightlight instead of Rest overnight (Natural light) and before bed (evening routine).
data_description.label_coming_home: Lights that come on in Natural light when someone arrives home.
data_description.label_exclude: Lights left out of everything: the dashboard, scenes, routines and dimmers. Hidden lights are left out too.
data_description.presence: The zone whose number of people decides coming home, leaving home and whether the evening routine starts.
data_description.dimmers: Let Hue Dimmer Switches (RWL02x) paired with ZHA control the lights in their area.

apply_preset.name: Apply preset
apply_preset.description: Sets lights to a Hue-style preset, taking them out of the Natural light scene and the evening routine. With no target, every light.

natural_light.name: Natural light
natural_light.description: Puts lights into the Natural light scene: they turn on and follow the sun until another scene is picked or they're changed by hand. With no target, every light.

follow.name: Follow natural light
follow.description: Turn off to take the lights out of the scene instead.

next_scene.name: Next scene
next_scene.description: Moves lights to the next scene, like pressing a Hue dimmer's On button again: Natural light, Energize, Cool bright, Relax, Rest, Nightlight, and round. Lights that are off come on in Natural light.
